summary: Verbatim DOM binding accepts presentation-only drift the authoring prompt already permits: any marker glyph may be omitted, and a pipe or arrow may stay attached to the edge of the element beside it.
invariants: Every source character outside a marker is rendered exactly, including blank fields, punctuation, and the separators between a span's own runs.
Runs of one block still appear in source order, and each run is still owned by exactly one visible DOM element.
Stamping (text_stamping) and the Chromium readback (browser_readback) accept the same renderings through SourceRunProjection.accepts.
accepted_texts keeps returning the canonical forms so receipts and repair logic are unchanged.
forbidden: Accept a dropped or moved pipe/arrow between two runs bound to one element.
Accept an item split across elements at anything but a projected run boundary.
Accept items of one block in a different order than the source.
rationale: The verbatim prompt tells the model bullet glyphs, circled numbers and leading arrows may be drawn separately or omitted; the gate only accepted the whole marker kept or the whole marker dropped, so '• ① 타깃:' rendered as '① 타깃:' failed.
A pipe joins two independent labels and the template decides the slot of each; models regularly leave the glyph on the first label ('꿀벌쌤 |'), which is layout, not a text change.
